## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; high sector participation versus neutral risk signals. VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND show mixed confirmation for a neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress neutral: HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND → HYG/LQD mixed (→ flat). Fear muted: VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds neutral: SPY/TLT → flat.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: USD and yield signals are flat (yield curve → flat; Dollar → flat). TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND points to modest bond outflows while HYG stable suggests no acute credit stress.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND; Tech constructive: XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials/Cloud strength via ITA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND and SKYY (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +21.23%) ABOVE TREND — style: cyclicals and growth both showing pockets of strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US holding up: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND. EM positive: EEM (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +3.77%) ABOVE TREND, while China soft: FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION — watch China idiosyncrasy.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation present but uneven: ARKK (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND; crypto under pressure: IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial metals constructive: CPER (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +5.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy rally obvious: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND. Nat gas mixed: UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad sector participation with XLE, XLK, SPY ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: FXI CORRECTION (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) highlight regional/crypto stress despite broad sector gains.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and select tech/industrial ETFs given breadth and momentum; reduce exposure to China-exposed (FXI) and crypto (IBIT) until price action stabilizes. Bonds neutral to underweight exposure given TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND; SKYY (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +21.23%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION; XRT (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND; SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY — watch for reversion.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD differential (watch LQD BELOW TREND vs HYG ABOVE TREND for credit health); XLE strength above recent 1M price band; FXI break below recent 1W low would confirm China weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, creating a mix of broad participation and flat risk signals. Energy (XLE 1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) and Tech (XLK 1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) showing strength. Key divergence to monitor: China FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) and crypto IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) as downside risks.
